title: Executivo Comercial Hunter - Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Natal, RN.
description:
No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!


Nosso negócio Fintech oferece para toda a região uma proposta de valor integral, que visa democratizar os serviços financeiros e satisfazer as necessidades de mais de 60 milhões de usuários e usuárias.

Disponibilizamos uma plataforma online que permite receber pelas vendas eletrônicas realizadas, tanto dentro como fora do Mercado Livre, e um sistema de códigos QR e dispositivos Point para as vendas realizadas no mundo físico, para milhões de comerciantes, empreendedores e profissionais, damos a possibilidade de processar suas operações com segurança, através de mais de 50 meios de pagamento na América Latina.

Além disso, fornecemos acesso gratuito a uma conta digital que permite pagar, enviar e receber dinheiro, gerar renda e trabalhar com cartões para fazer compras ou saques. Através do Mercado Crédito, concedemos créditos para satisfazer as necessidades daqueles a quem prestamos nossos serviços e potencializar os negócios de quem vende através da nossa plataforma.



Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:

  • Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites.
  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.
  • A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas.
  • Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão.
  • Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.



Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:


  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com o perfil de Grandes Contas.
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, compreendendo as dores e oportunidades dos clientes para propor soluções completas de valor agregado ao negócio.
  • Gerir todo o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento e onboarding do cliente sendo usuário modelo dos sistemas da companhia.
  • Sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes e parceiros de negócio e monitorar tendências de mercado, comportamento da concorrência e oportunidades de crescimento para a sua região de atuação.
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com equipes de produtos e operações para garantir a melhor entrega ao cliente.
  • Ser consultivo para atuar no detalhe durante as negociações sobre os serviços financeiros do Mercado Pago, Meios de Pagamento e Software de Gestão.



Requisitos:


  • Possuir graduação completa.
  • Ter experiência na prospecção de clientes para grandes contas no sesgmento de meios de pagamento.
  • Contar com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B nos segmentos de serviços financeiros, adquirência ou meios de pagamento.
  • Possuir vivência comercial em cenários de metas.
  • Possuir disponibilidade para trabalho presencial.
  • Possuir carro próprio.



Nós lhe propomos:

  • Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo.
  • Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores.
  • Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas.
  • Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)



O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!

title: Desenvolvedor
description:
Desenvolvedor(a) .NET + Python + AWS


Modalidade: remoto

Tipo de Contrato: CLT


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, testar e manter aplicações em .NET e Python, garantindo a eficiência e escalabilidade dos sistemas.

- Projetar e implementar soluções em nuvem utilizando AWS, incluindo serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS e outros.

- Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para entender requisitos de negócios e traduzir em soluções técnicas eficazes.

- Participar na definição de arquiteturas de sistemas e na escolha de tecnologias apropriadas para os projetos.

- Implementar práticas de DevOps, incluindo CI/CD, automação de testes e monitoramento de aplicações.

- Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de desenvolvimento e da qualidade do código.


Requisitos:

- Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicações com .NET (C# ou VB.NET).

- Proficiência em Python e suas bibliotecas comuns.

- Conhecimento prático de serviços AWS e arquiteturas de nuvem.

- Familiaridade com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (SQL, NoSQL).

- Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, etc.).

- Habilidade em trabalhar em equipe e excelentes habilidades de comunicação.


Diferenciais:

- Certificações em AWS ou outras tecnologias relevantes.

- Experiência em contêineres (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Conhecimento em práticas de segurança na nuvem.

title: Data Consultant Brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)

title: Arquiteto(a) de Infraestrutura
description:
A Foursys é apaixonada por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais. Somos GPTW. E somos movidos por pessoas.

♿


Na Foursys, acreditamos que diversidade é potência. Valorizamos diferentes histórias, ideias e perspectivas — aqui, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras. São parte do que nos fortalece.

Quer fazer parte do time e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent ? Então olha essa oportunidade


Arquiteto(a) de Infraestrutura


Sobre a oportunidade:


Atividades:

• Arquitetura Azure: Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando o framework de boa arquitetura da MS.

• Orquestração de Containers: Administrar e otimizar clusters AKS garantindo a saúde, monitoramento e o ciclo de vida das aplicações.

• Modernização: Liderar a transição de workloads legados (On-premises/VMs) para arquiteturas modernas (PaaS, IaaS, SaaS e Containers).

• Automação e DevOps: Evoluir as rotinas de automação para uma cultura de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), utilizando Terraform ou Bicep.

• Identidade e Segurança: Conhecimento em B2C, EntraID garantindo políticas de acesso seguro (Conditional Access, RBAC).

• Gestão de Performance: Monitorar proativamente a saúde do ambiente Azure (Azure Monitor/Log Analytics/App Insights)


Diferencial desejado:

• Conhecimento em estratégias de migração (Cloud Adoption Framework).

• Experiência com ferramentas de CI/CD (Azure DevOps).

• Certificações: AZ-104 (Administrador) e AZ-900 (Fundamentos).

• Grande Diferencial: Certificação AZ-305 (Architect Design) e AZ-700 (Networking).


Qualidade pessoais desejadas:

• Capacidade analítica: Lidar com grandes volumes de dados exige identificar padrões, tendências e anomalias.Extrair insights de informações complexas é indispensável.

• Atenção aos detalhes: Pequenas variações nos dados podem indicar problemas sérios. É necessário ser meticuloso e preciso na análise de informações.

• Habilidade de resolução de problemas:

• Identificar a raiz de problemas e desenvolver soluções é essencial.

• Pensar de forma lógica e sistemática para resolver desafios complexos.

• Comunicação eficaz: Comunicar informações técnicas de forma clara é vital para colaborar com equipes diversas. Explicar conceitos complexos de forma compreensível para diferentes públicos.

• Proatividade: Antecipar problemas e tomar medidas preventivas.

• Identificar áreas de melhoria e implementar soluções proativamente.

• Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão: Incidentes críticos exigem respostas rápidas e eficazes. Manter a calma e tomar decisões assertivas em situações de alta pressão.

• Aprendizado contínuo: A tecnologia evolui constantemente, exigindo aprendizado de novas ferramentas e técnicas. Curiosidade e desejo de se manter atualizado.

• Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar, compartilhar informações e auxiliar colegas é essencial para alcançar objetivos.

Experiência anterior desejada:

• Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em infraestrutura de TI, com vivência comprovada em ambientes robustos e missões críticas.

• Domínio Microsoft: Sólido conhecimento em AKS, ferramentas dos ambientes IaaS, PaaS e SaaS.

• Cloud: Experiência prática em administração de recursos Azure (Networking, App Services e Storage).

• Automação: Expertise em Azure CLI, Terraform para automação de processos e gestão de configurações.

• Resiliência: Experiência em planos de Disaster Recovery (DR) e atuação em crises com elaboração de laudos de causa raiz (RCA).


Habilidades Técnicas:

- Azure

- AKS

- AZ-104

- AZ-900

- estratégias de migração

- IaC

- Terraform

- Bicep

- On-premises

- SaaS

- Containers

- PaaS


Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Remoto


Benefícios | Clube da Four

title: Agente CyberHelpDesk con Español - Portugues
description:
Lazarus Technology, líder en el sector de la ciberseguridad para aseguradoras, buscamos un agente con CyberHelpdesk con idiomas de Portugués y Español (ambos) con pasión por la tecnología y un compromiso firme con la seguridad de la información. Este rol es esencial para garantizar una experiencia segura y confiable para nuestros clientes, brindando soporte básico en caso de incidentes de seguridad. A través de medios como teléfono, chat, correo electrónico y sistemas de ticketing, serás la primera línea de atención junto con tus responsables, ayudando a nuestros clientes a resolver problemas de seguridad básicos. Este puesto ofrece la oportunidad de trabajar de manera remota, de lunes a viernes en horario laboral, permitiéndote equilibrar tu vida profesional y personal.


Responsabilidades:

  • Brindar asistencia directa a clientes que experimentan micro incidentes de seguridad, utilizando diversos medios de comunicación como teléfono, chat, correo electrónico y sistemas de ticketing.
  • Diagnosticar y resolver problemas técnicos relacionados con la seguridad de los equipos informáticos.
  • Soporte en incidentes de ciberseguridad.
  • Asesorar a clientes sobre medidas preventivas y mejores prácticas en seguridad para minimizar riesgos futuros.


Requisitos Obligatorios:

  • Excelente habilidad de comunicación oral y escrita en español y portugués. Si tienes un tercer idioma será bienvenido.
  • Excelente trato con clientes.
  • Conocimientos básicos en ciberseguridad, incluyendo comprensión de los incidentes de seguridad más actuales y medidas preventivas.
  • Experiencia previa en roles de soporte técnico en ciberseguridad o helpdesk es deseable.
  • Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma en un entorno remoto, y con el resto del equipo.


Ofrecemos:

  • La oportunidad de unirse a un equipo líder en el ámbito de la ciberseguridad en el mundo asegurador, donde podrás crecer profesionalmente y aportar a la seguridad de nuestros clientes.
  • Un entorno de trabajo flexible y remoto, permitiéndote trabajar desde cualquier lugar.
  • Horario laboral de lunes a viernes, con respeto por tu equilibrio entre vida laboral y personal.
  • Si tienes pasión por la tecnología y un firme compromiso con la seguridad, te invitamos a postularte a este rol vital dentro de nuestra empresa. Buscamos personas proactivas, listos para enfrentar los desafíos de la ciberseguridad en nuestro equipo.

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.


Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Job description

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join a North American team supporting a hybrid environment with a strong focus on VMware and Azure Cloud. This role is primarily hands-on and involves managing, modernizing, and migrating a large-scale virtualized environment to the cloud, while also supporting core networking and security components. The ideal candidate brings deep VMware and Azure experience, strong production support capabilities, and the ability to work across infrastructure, cloud, and networking domains in a collaborative, hybrid-specialist team.


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize a large VMware environment across multiple physical hosts.
  • Support migration initiatives from on-premises VMware infrastructure to Microsoft Azure.
  • Design and implement cloud-based solutions in Azure, ensuring scalability, security, and high availability.
  • Build and maintain disaster recovery strategies across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Administer and support VMware platforms, including vCenter, vSAN, and related virtualization components.
  • Support and manage Microsoft 365 (O365) services within the broader infrastructure ecosystem.
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot infrastructure issues across virtualized, cloud, and network layers.
  • Support networking components including firewalls, routing, switching, VPNs, and secure access solutions.
  • Work with security platforms such as Zscaler and contribute to overall infrastructure security posture.
  • Participate in modernization projects aimed at improving system performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional IT and security teams to align infrastructure with business needs.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, system diagrams, and operational procedures.


Job Requirements

  • 8–10+ years of hands-on experience in infrastructure engineering, systems administration, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Strong expertise in VMware technologies (vSphere, vCenter, vSAN) in production environments.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including migrations, compute, networking, and storage services.
  • Proven experience managing and supporting large virtualized environments.
  • Experience designing and implementing disaster recovery solutions across hybrid infrastructures.
  • Working knowledge of core networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and switching.
  • Experience with secure access and SASE platforms such as Zscaler is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 (O365) administration.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, cloud, and networking layers.
  • Experience with performance monitoring tools and infrastructure observability.
  • Ability to work in a hybrid specialist team and handle multiple responsibilities across domains.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to prioritize work in a dynamic environment.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., VMware, Azure, CCNP) are preferred but not mandatory if experience is strong.

The ideal candidate brings deep VMware and Azure experience, strong production support capabilities, and the ability to work across infrastructure, cloud, and networking domains in a collaborative, hybrid-specialist team.


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize a large VMware environment across multiple physical hosts.
  • Support migration initiatives from on-premises VMware infrastructure to Microsoft Azure.
  • Design and implement cloud-based solutions in Azure, ensuring scalability, security, and high availability.
  • Build and maintain disaster recovery strategies across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Administer and support VMware platforms, including vCenter, vSAN, and related virtualization components.
  • Support and manage Microsoft 365 (O365) services within the broader infrastructure ecosystem.
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot infrastructure issues across virtualized, cloud, and network layers.
  • Support networking components including firewalls, routing, switching, VPNs, and secure access solutions.
  • Work with security platforms such as Zscaler and contribute to overall infrastructure security posture.
  • Participate in modernization projects aimed at improving system performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional IT and security teams to align infrastructure with business needs.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, system diagrams, and operational procedures.


Job Requirements

  • 8–10+ years of hands-on experience in infrastructure engineering, systems administration, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Strong expertise in VMware technologies (vSphere, vCenter, vSAN) in production environments.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including migrations, compute, networking, and storage services.
  • Proven experience managing and supporting large virtualized environments.
  • Experience designing and implementing disaster recovery solutions across hybrid infrastructures.
  • Working knowledge of core networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and switching.
  • Experience with secure access and SASE platforms such as Zscaler is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 (O365) administration.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, cloud, and networking layers.
  • Experience with performance monitoring tools and infrastructure observability.
  • Ability to work in a hybrid specialist team and handle multiple responsibilities across domains.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to prioritize work in a dynamic environment.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., VMware, Azure, CCNP) are preferred but not mandatory if experience is strong.

title: Desenvolvedor Python –  Backend (remote)
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Python Developer com foco em backend para atuar em um time internacional e multicultural , colaborando com profissionais de diferentes países em projetos globais de dados. Trata-se de uma oportunidade em uma grande consultoria global de tecnologia , reconhecida por atuar em projetos complexos de transformação digital para grandes empresas ao redor do mundo.


A posição é 100% remota , com contratação no modelo PJ , e exige inglês avançado , já que a comunicação diária acontece com times e stakeholders internacionais.


Principais responsabilidades

• Forte proficiência em Python e desenvolvimento backend.

• Experiência no desenho e construção de APIs RESTful e microsserviços.

• Sólido entendimento de código limpo, design modular, testes e controle de versão.

• Experiência prática com plataformas de nuvem Azure e/ou AWS.

• Experiência em conteinerização de aplicações com Docker e orquestração com Kubernetes (ex.: AKS ou EKS).

• Experiência na implementação de pipelines de CI/CD.


Habilidades Desejáveis

• Experiência na implantação ou integração de serviços baseados em LLM ou orientados por IA em ambientes de produção.

• Familiaridade com plataformas de chatbot, frameworks de IA conversacional ou APIs de serviços de IA.


Perfil buscado

  • Forte base técnica em SQL e backend
  • Capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas
  • Boa comunicação para interação em times internacionais
  • Experiência colaborando com times multidisciplinares

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Software (Java)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

Atuar diretamente nos produtos da BU de Investimentos, apoiando o desenho técnico, decisões e evolução arquitetural dos sistemas;

● Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de escalabilidade, performance e estabilidade nos sistemas core da BU;

● Definir e acompanhar rotas de modernização tecnológica (Java/Spring Boot, Oracle, serviços distribuídos, cloud, mensageria, data streaming);

● Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa e representar a BU nos fóruns técnicos e estratégicos;

● Desenvolver e manter padrões arquiteturais específicos para a BU (design patterns, governança, observabilidade, práticas de versionamento, guidelines de APIs);

● Elaborar e gerenciar artefatos de decisão técnica (ADRs, RFCs, RFPs), documentando mudanças estruturais e justificativas;

● Apoiar squads na modelagem de domínios, integrações, definição de SLAs/SLIs/SLOs e desenho de fluxos críticos;

● Conduzir análises de capacidade, modelagem de volumetria, tuning de JVM e banco Oracle, e estratégias para cargas de alto volume;

● Avaliar e introduzir tecnologias que suportem o roadmap da BU: mensageria/eventos (Kafka), in-memory (Redis), observabilidade, caching, automação;

● Atuar em incidentes críticos, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções estruturais para performance, estabilidade e resiliência;

● Propor e desenvolver PoCs e experimentos técnicos relacionados a modernização, cloud, dados e IA;

● Colaborar com Data & Analytics na definição de integrações, governança e estratégias de movimentação de dados;

● Influenciar boas práticas de engenharia (clean code, testes, CI/CD, padrões de API, segurança, resiliência);

● Trabalhar lado a lado com líderes técnicos, POs e engenharia para construir um backlog tecnicamente sustentável e evolutivo.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:

● Profundo conhecimento em Java e Spring Boot (indispensável)

● Experiência com arquiteturas modernas: microservices, event-driven, hexagonal, DDD e integração entre sistemas legacy e modernos

● Forte experiência prática em troubleshooting de escalabilidade, performance, tuning e concorrência


Bancos de Dados e Persistência

● Domínio de bancos relacionais, especialmente Oracle (query tuning, índices, particionamento, análise de planos)

● Conhecimento em bancos NoSQL e cache distribuído (Redis, MongoDB, Elastic)


Cloud, DevOps e Observabilidade

● Vivência com nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e arquitetura cloud-ready

● CI/CD (GitLab, GitHub Actions e Jenkins (principal))

● Observabilidade e resiliência: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Elastic, tracing distribuído, circuit breakers


Segurança e Compliance

● Experiência com autenticação/autorização (OAuth2, OIDC, JWT), mTLS

● Conhecimento de OWASP Top 10, boas práticas de API Security e criptografia

● Compreensão de requisitos regulatórios financeiros (LGPD, PCI, normas de mercado financeiro são diferencial)


Metodologias e Governança Técnica

● Vivência com Scrum/Kanban, Lean, ITIL, framework SAFe, SRE e práticas de engenharia moderna

● Governança de arquitetura, gestão de risco técnico e processos decisórios estruturados

● Documentação técnica: ADRs, C4 Model, ArchiMate, Confluence, draw.io


Mentalidade e Comportamentos

● Visão sistêmica, pensamento crítico e capacidade de simplificar arquiteturas complexas

● Ter capacidade de aprender qualquer tecnologia de Frameworks e linguagens diversas. Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.js, Python, PHP, etc

● Proatividade para identificar gargalos e conduzir melhorias de impacto

● Perfil colaborativo e orientado a influenciar engenharia com profundidade técnica

● Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes de missão crítica (core de investimentos)

● Fome por evolução tecnológica, dados, automação e inovação contínua


DIFERENCIAL:

● Conhecimento do mercado financeiro de investimentos.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Software (Java)
description:
A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

Atuar diretamente nos produtos da BU de Investimentos, apoiando o desenho técnico, decisões e evolução arquitetural dos sistemas;

● Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas complexos de escalabilidade, performance e estabilidade nos sistemas core da BU;

● Definir e acompanhar rotas de modernização tecnológica (Java/Spring Boot, Oracle, serviços distribuídos, cloud, mensageria, data streaming);

● Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura corporativa e representar a BU nos fóruns técnicos e estratégicos;

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.



*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***


This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Salesforce)
description:
About us

First Line Software works with some of the world's top businesses and organizations across industries such as healthcare, real estate, data engineering, warehouse automation, retail digitalization, mobile app development, and e-commerce.

Our projects are as diverse as our people — and we believe in building software through collaboration, transparency, and shared success.

Let's see what we can create together!


About the project

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer (Salesforce) to join a long-term project and support the improvement of deployment processes across multiple systems, including Salesforce and web applications .

In this role, you will work closely with an existing DevOps setup and client-side leadership, contributing to automation, reliability, and efficient delivery pipelines. This is a hands-on position for someone who enjoys improving workflows, reducing manual effort, and working independently within a collaborative environment.


Responsibilities

  • Drive improvements in deployment workflows across Salesforce and other applications, reducing manual steps and increasing reliability
  • Design and implement CI/CD pipelines , including solutions tailored for Salesforce
  • Improve and maintain version control practices to ensure traceability and safe rollbacks
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen DevOps culture and best practices
  • Support release management, monitoring, and environment stability (SRE-related tasks)
  • Ensure security and compliance standards are followed across deployments
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve automation, performance, and delivery processes


Requirements

  • Strong experience with DevOps practices and process improvement
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce DX, SF CLI, and Developer Tools , including deployments and configurations
  • Experience building and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (YAML/JSON), preferably with Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (ARM templates, Bicep, or Terraform)
  • Solid experience working with Azure (App Services, KeyVault, Azure SQL, Storage Accounts, VNet)
  • Nice to have: exposure to AWS or GCP
  • Scripting skills in PowerShell and/or Bash
  • Strong understanding of version control systems (Git or similar)
  • Experience supporting release management and monitoring (SRE concepts)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work independently in a distributed team


What we can offer

The FLS difference

  • Our modern stack projects are the right mix of exciting and challenging
  • Gain access to our diverse range of training programs, courses, and certifications
  • Choose your work style - remote, on-site or hybrid in one of our stunning offices.
  • Enhance your language skills with our corporate English classes
  • Work from anywhere and explore the world with our Workation program

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
We are looking for a remote Technical Recruiter based in Latin America with 2 to 5 years of experience and excellent English skills, who has a keen eye for detail and a knack for finding ways to get it done.


We are a growth-stage company that works fast and smart. We want ambitious people who want to grow their skills. At Velozient, you will feel your contribution daily to the success of the team! We are not a huge company where you will get lost in the mix or stuck in a role.


Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of the Talent Pipeline and candidate engagement.
  • Conduct 1:1 interviews with qualified candidates.
  • Continuously assess and improve the recruitment process for efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Screen all the candidates and evaluate their fit for the opening.
  • Implement best practices to streamline workflows and enhance the overall recruitment experience.
  • Proactively conduct the full life cycle of identifying, engaging, and evaluating top candidates.
  • Collaborate with internal Resource Managers to ensure Velozient meets and exceeds client hiring goals, budgets, and performance standards.
  • Assure accurate/timely issuance of offer letters and clean/effective transition of candidates to the onboarding team.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & EXPERIENCE

REQUIRED (Must Have):

  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Minimum of 3 to 5 years of experience in Recruiting, with at least two years in Technical Recruitment.
  • Proficiency in using social media platforms for networking purposes.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment.
  • Familiarity with ApplicantTracking Systems and other recruitment tools is a plus.


Preferred (But not required):

  • University degree
  • Prior work for another North American-based company
  • Prior experience in a fast-paced, growth-stage, entrepreneurial company


What YOU Get!

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - let’s learn from them -be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), designated national holidays, three sick leave days, and one floating day annually

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados AWS
description:
Profissional para construir e escalar pipelines em Databricks/Spark na AWS, suportando iniciativas de AI/ML e projetos de analytics/BI, em colaboração com times globais.


Principais atividades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e otimizar pipelines em Databricks/Spark (batch/streaming) com qualidade, performance e observabilidade.
  • Integrar e orquestrar dados na AWS (S3, Glue, Athena/Redshift), garantindo governança e segurança.
  • Construir datasets e pipelines para AI/ML (feature engineering, dados para treino e inferência).
  • Atender demandas end-to-end de dados para produtos e BI (ingestão, transformação e disponibilização).


Requisitos:

  • Domínio de Databricks e Apache Spark em produção.
  • Experiência prática com a stack AWS para dados/analytics.
  • Forte base em SQL e Python, com boas práticas de versionamento e CI/CD de dados.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para reuniões com times globais.


Informações adicionais:

  • Atuação remota
  • Contratação CLT

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Hiring for Sr. Project Manager | Long Term Contract | Remote


Role: Sr. Project Manager

Initial Duration: Long Term Contract

Remote / EST Time zone (Nearshore Candidates)


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Client is in need of a versatile Sr. Project Manager, to assist in a number of different projects, within the PMO. These will consist of both application and infrastructure projects, moreso slanting towards applications.
  • Need a strong Leader / communicator, who can work with various levels of the organization, and both business and IT teams to drive projects.
  • Client mostly waterfall in their methodology, with some projects being somewhat more iterative.
  • PMP Certification would be a bonus, but need someone with strong methodology / process acumen

Must:

  • Strong Project Management
  • Able to manage variety of projects, including ERP, Application and Infrastructure projects
  • Work with Business and IT teams, and third party vendors
  • Broad IT PM Expertise
  • Ability to manage projects across multiple functional areas, including Applications, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, etc.,
  • preferably in a waterfall environment, but broader experience is welcome.
  • Strong Communication
  • Skilled at engaging stakeholders across all levels and functions, with the ability to create clear documentation and straightforward status updates.
  • Risk & Budget Management
  • Expertise in mitigating risks proactively and managing budgets/resources effectively.
  • Leadership Ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive accountability with a bias toward action.

Nice-to-have:

  • PMP Certification
  • Specialty Chemical Industry experience
  • Brazil-based, Portuguese speaking

title: ITSM Support Specialist
description:
We are looking for an Ivanti ITSM Specialist to take over the managed support and administration of an existing Ivanti environment. The main goal is to ensure platform stability, manage day-to-day operations, and support the ITSM application while parallel assessments are running.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Administration: Handle day-to-day configuration and maintenance of the Ivanti ITSM platform.
  • Queue Management: Manage incident and request queues, performing triage and ensuring timely resolution.
  • User Management: Administer users, groups, and maintain the service catalog.
  • Reporting: Generate and maintain dashboards and operational reports as needed.
  • Maintenance & Support: Provide minor enhancements and break-fix support to ensure \"nothing stops, nothing breaks.\"
  • Vendor Liaison: Act as the point of contact with Ivanti vendors for technical escalations.

Technical Requirements (Must-haves)

  • Experience: Proven experience administering Ivanti Service Management (ISM) or Ivanti Neurons for ITSM .
  • ITSM Knowledge: Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes (Incident, Request, Change management).
  • Reporting: Ability to run and customize reports within the Ivanti environment.
  • Soft Skills: Proactive \"keep the lights on\" mindset, ability to work independently, and clear communication.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack
description:
We're Hiring: Senior Software Engineer | Remote from Brazil | Fluent English required


Location : Remote – Brazil only

Contact: PJ - Long Term


We are looking for a kind, curious, and experienced Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who enjoys solving challenging problems and building impactful user experiences. You’ll join a collaborative and supportive engineering team focused on making it seamless and compelling for users to engage with our platform.

This is a fully remote role reporting to the Engineering Manager of Customer Experience, with strong opportunities for technical leadership, mentorship, and personal growth .


What You’ll Do

  • Write high-quality, scalable, and testable code that drives key business initiatives
  • Contribute hands-on while also helping shape the technical direction of the team
  • Build and maintain features using modern technologies such as:
  • Elixir, Ruby
  • React, TypeScript, GraphQL
  • Kafka, AWS (Lambda)
  • PostgreSQL, DynamoDB
  • Participate in architecture and design decisions
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback
  • Collaborate closely with teammates through pair programming
  • Deploy and monitor user-facing features in production
  • Continuously learn and explore new technologies and patterns


What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong proficiency in Elixir or Ruby
  • Solid experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML, and CSS
  • Hands-on experience with React and its ecosystem (Node.js, npm)
  • Familiarity with:
  • RESTful APIs
  • Git and version control workflows
  • TypeScript
  • Remote deployment tools
  • Understanding of event-driven architectures , databases , and GraphQL
  • A problem-solving mindset with a focus on user impact
  • Interest in e-commerce, retail, or building sustainable digital ecosystems


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Kafka (event streaming)
  • Experience transitioning from monoliths to microservices architectures


Why Join Us

  • Work with a supportive and collaborative team that values growth
  • Have real influence on technical decisions and product direction
  • Be part of a mission-driven environment focused on innovation and sustainability
  • Continuous opportunities for learning, mentorship, and career development

title: Team Leader | adidas Belém
description:
Objetivo e Relevância Global para a Organização:


Contribuir para o alcance das metas de KPI da Loja, proporcionando uma experiência memorável para os consumidores e praticando os Valores da Marca. Apoiar a liderança e as operações da loja como terceiro responsável e gerenciar a equipe designada. Utilizar conhecimento e experiência para vender aos consumidores, atendê-los e alcançar excelência operacional, além de executar operações de loja perfeitamente quando for responsável pelo fluxo de produtos entre a área de vendas, o estoque e/ou o caixa, seguindo os procedimentos.


Principais Responsabilidades:


• Apoiar as operações de vendas da loja e os funcionários como terceiro responsável, cumprindo a função de gerente responsável na ausência do Store Manager e do Assistant Store Manager para assegurar o gerenciamento e a supervisão da loja, garantindo o cumprimento dos padrões de atendimento da adidas.

• Colaborar na obtenção dos KPIs da loja e garantir que a equipe tenha ciência deles e da forma como contribuem, e sugerir ajustes necessários para aumentar a produtividade e a eficiência no atendimento e na área de vendas.

• Contribuir para que as políticas e os procedimentos da loja sejam cumpridos de forma a manter um ambiente de trabalho e de compras seguro e apoiar o treinamento da equipe para garantir os padrões da adidas e reduzir riscos.

• Supervisionar e apoiar as diferentes tarefas da loja (por exemplo, caixa, estoque e vendas), executando-as em conjunto com a equipe, se necessário, para garantir o funcionamento da loja e o atendimento ao consumidor.

• Liderar, motivar a equipe designada e apoiar o recrutamento e o treinamento de outros membros da equipe, fornecendo as ferramentas necessárias para ter performance e atingir os objetivos da loja, garantindo o engajamento dos funcionários, a produtividade e a cultura de alta performance, e liderando pelo exemplo enquanto defensor da Marca, demonstrando consistentemente a cultura para reforçar os valores da adidas.

• Apoiar o Store Manager no treinamento da equipe em todas as ferramentas e soluções de vendas digitais e omnicanais, além de prestar atendimento de pós-venda para garantir uma experiência de compra perfeita.

• Concluir todos os programas de treinamento aplicáveis, incluindo Foundational e Seasonal Brand, além de ter conhecimento sobre o produto, colocando o aprendizado na prática com eficácia.

• Trabalhar sempre priorizando a equipe, em total respeito com todos os colegas e contribuindo ativamente para tornar seu local de trabalho um ambiente inclusivo e acolhedor para todos.


Habilidades e Conhecimentos:


• Conhecimento de todas as ferramentas e processos operacionais da loja, do funcionamento da loja e de como atingir os KPIs.

• Compreensão dos padrões de Visual Merchandising para impulsionar a conversão através de ações estratégicas.

• Conectar, engajar e inspirar ativamente os consumidores.

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.


By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Portuguese Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and skilled Gen AI Data Annotation Analysts to join our global remote teams. Analysts will perform annotations across various modalities—including text, image, and video—to deliver high-quality datasets essential for training and refining cutting- edge Generative AI models.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Annotate high-quality training data across text, image, and video modalities, adhering strictly to provided project guidelines.
  • Generate accurate data annotation as per project requirements.
  • Apply critical thinking and logical decision-making when handling ambiguous data scenarios.
  • Proactively identify and report annotation tool issues, bugs, or potential improvements.
  • Collaborate with Language Leads, Project Managers, and technical teams to ensure annotation tasks meet quality standards.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong analytical skills for identifying inaccuracies and ensuring annotation precision.
  • Proficiency in adapting to various project specifications and guidelines.
  • Excellent reading comprehension skills in the target language equivalent to CEFR B2 and above.
  • Strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple annotation tasks efficiently and independently.
  • Comfort handling social media content, demonstrating proficiency at a minimum of understanding PII and NER related content.
  • Ability to quickly learn and navigate diverse annotation platforms and tools.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content.
  • Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles.


What We Offer:

  • An innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and growth.
  • Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements.
  • Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology.


Join iMerit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of

Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage

you to apply!

title: Scrum master
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Scrum Master , who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will:

Facilitate Scrum events (Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives).

Collect and analyze performance metrics to identify areas for improvement and ensure value delivery and continuous improvement.

Act as a mentor and coach for the team, encouraging self-management and team autonomy.

Support the Product Owner to ensure a clear and prioritized backlog aligned with business objectives.

Remove impediments that hinder the team's progress.

Implement risk management practices, identifying risks and working on mitigation.

Keep stakeholders updated on the progress of the teams and deliveries.


Mandatory Skills:

  • Experience with global and remote distributed teams.
  • Ability to mediate and resolve conflicts/impediments within and outside the team.
  • Certification as a Scrum Master (CSM/PSM).
  • Knowledge of Atlassian tools (Jira, Confluence) is a plus.
  • Availability to work in the Eastern Time (EST) zone.
  • Leadership: Strong leadership, project management, and team collaboration skills.
  • Languages: Portuguese, fluent English to work with a globally distributed team, Spanish is a differencial
  • Agile Frameworks: Proven experience and knowledge of Scrum and/or Kanban.
  • Metrics: Experience with agile metrics such as velocity, burndown/burnup, CFD, quality, and flow metrics to assess team performance and foster a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Communication Skills: Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with the team and other stakeholders.
  • Problem-solving: Creative and proactive attitude to seek solutions, improvements, and to adapt quickly.
  • Advanced English

title: Senior Helpdesk Support Specialist
description:
Position Overview
As a senior member of our IT support team, you will provide advanced, second-level technical assistance to end-users, resolving complex issues related to computer hardware, software, and systems within a Windows-based environment. A significant component of this position involves coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to Level 1 help desk technicians, contributing directly to the team's growth and the achievement of leadership goals. You will serve as a key escalation point, performing in-depth diagnostics, implementing solutions, and managing small IT projects. Key responsibilities include basic network connectivity triage for LAN, WAN, and wireless access points, asset management administration, and maintaining a comprehensive knowledge base to enable proactive problem resolution. This role requires performing basic Active Directory tasks, Microsoft 365 troubleshooting, and device management using Microsoft Intune, ensuring the daily performance and stability of our computer systems. Position title: Senior Helpdesk Support SpecialistLocation: Remote - LATAM
Key Responsibilities
  • Help supervise ticket flow in Jira, ensuring proper triage, routing, and escalation.
  • Mentor, coach, and provide technical guidance to Level 1 helpdesk technicians to support their professional development and ensure overall team success.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex end-user IT issues, providing advanced second-level support for computer systems, hardware, and software.
  • Manage small-scale IT projects, overseeing tasks and special assignments to ensure successful completion and alignment with departmental objectives.
  • Proactively identify recurring technical problems, implementing permanent solutions and making recommendations for IT improvements to reduce incident volume.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues by installing, modifying, and repairing computer software, and peripherals on Windows operating systems.
  • Perform basic network triage for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points to resolve initial connectivity issues before escalation.
  • Execute fundamental administrative tasks in Active Directory, such as account unlocks and password resets, and provide end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 applications.
  • Utilize Microsoft Intune for key device management functions.
  • Administer the IT asset management system, ensuring accurate tracking and documentation of software assets.
  • Develop, preserve, and grow a comprehensive knowledge base of procedures and solutions for both internal help desk use and end-user self-help resources.
  • Strong documentation discipline and ability to follow and improve SOPs and knowledge base articles
  • Design and conduct training sessions for computer users to enhance their technical proficiency and understanding of IT systems.
  • Manage and progress tickets in Jira Service Management, including triage, updates, proper routing, and escalation.
  • Basic familiarity with endpoint security and antivirus concepts is helpful, issues are typically escalated to the appropriate security team.
Required Skills & Experience
  • Proven experience providing remote help desk and desktop support, including diagnosing, guiding, and resolving issues related to computer hardware, software, and peripherals through virtual and phone-based assistance.
  • Demonstrated leadership abilities, including experience providing technical guidance, coaching, and mentoring to junior help desk technicians.
  • Working knowledge of help desk software and remote control tools.
  • Experience working in Jira Service Management, or strong experience with similar ITSM ticketing systems and workflows.
  • Experience with basic Active Directory user management, such as password changes and account unlocks, and providing end-user troubleshooting for Microsoft 365.
  • Proficiency in resolving basic connectivity issues for Local Area Networks (LAN), Wide Area Networks (WAN), and wireless access points through basic triage.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to develop training materials and maintain a knowledge base.
  • Proven ability to manage small IT projects and perform asset management administration.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment.
Nice to Have Skills
  • Professional IT certifications, such as CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft IT Support.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune for device enrollment via Windows Autopilot and performing machine resets.
  • Experience with PowerShell scripting to automate routine administrative tasks.
  • Knowledge of supporting additional operating systems, such as macOS, iOS, or Android.
  • Experience with advanced network troubleshooting using command-line tools.
Soft Skills
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with a focus on coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to junior team members to foster their growth and ensure overall team success.
  • Exceptional communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation), with the ability to convey complex technical solutions clearly to clients of varying proficiency levels and to conduct effective training sessions.
  • Advanced analytical and troubleshooting abilities, characterized by a proactive approach to not only resolve immediate issues but also to identify root causes and implement solutions that prevent future occurrences.
  • A strong client-centric mindset, demonstrating the ability to understand problems from the user's perspective and guide them through the resolution process with patience and clarity.
  • Proven ability to work effectively within a high-performing team environment, collaborating with colleagues and assisting other IT support teams to share knowledge and achieve common goals.
  • Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, including the ability to manage small IT projects, maintain meticulous attention to detail, and exercise sound judgment in tracking, routing, and escalating support tickets.
Why You Will Love Working with Us
Join a powerful tech workforce and help us change the world through technology Professional development opportunities with international customers Collaborative work environment Career path and mentorship programs that will lead to new levels. Join Lean Tech and contribute to shaping the data landscape within a dynamic and growing organization. Your skills will be honed, and your contributions will play a vital role in our continued success. Lean Tech is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusiveenvironment for all employees.

title: Consultor Salesforce - Marketing Cloud Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 59257


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 33 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei #fera em marketing cloud, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um(a) #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência em Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Habilidades com Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Email Studio, Automation Studio.
  • Desejável: conhecimento em Data Cloud, SQL para manipulação de dados dentro do automation e noções de governança e boas práticas dentro do SFMC.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira!


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!
