Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

• Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"at-risk\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.

• Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.

• SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.

• Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.


2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus)

• Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.

• Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.


Technical Requirements

• Data Handling: 1–3 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.

• SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.

• Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).

• Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).


Operational Requirements

• Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.

• Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in \"noisy\" data, and propose actionable solutions.

• Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.

• Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

• Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.

• Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.

• Prior Forecasting experience


Location: LATAM (Must align with US PST Time Zone)


Language Requirement:

Advanced English

title: Direct Response Ads | Video Editor
description:
About Hydroh:


We’re one of the fastest-growing Shopify-based DTC brands in the world at the forefront of all things hydrogen water.


Our product line includes hydrogen water bottles, supplements, and accessories all designed to help people recover faster, reduce inflammation, and feel their best.


We’re looking for a Performance Video Editor who deeply understands how to cut direct response ads for Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. This is NOT a branding video role we’re talking scroll-stopping hooks, retention-driven pacing, and revenue-first editing.


Compensation & Perks:

  • Base Salary + Performance Bonus (Depending on experience and skillset)
  • Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine)
  • Fully Remote
  • Resources, trainings, and courses covered we invest in our people.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years experience editing direct response video ads for DTC brands
  • Portfolio of paid ads you've edited (Meta, TikTok, YT Shorts — performance-focused)
  • Advanced skills in Adobe Premiere, After Effects, or equivalent
  • Strong understanding of performance editing — you know what makes a video convert
  • Experience editing UGC-style content, influencer videos, and testimonial formats
  • Ability to follow creative briefs and storyboards, but also contribute your own ideas
  • Comfortable with iterating quickly based on feedback and performance data
  • Clear communicator and proactive with timelines

Bonus Points:

  • Experience working with health & wellness or skincare brands
  • Familiarity with tools like Frame.io, Slack, and Notion
  • Understanding of hooks, angles, and stages of awareness
  • Editing for long-form VSLs


What you'll be doing:

  • Edit short-form performance videos (15–90 seconds) optimized for Meta and TikTok
  • Implement scroll-stopping hooks, fast-paced edits, dynamic subtitles, and retention overlays
  • Work closely with our Creative Strategist and UGC Project Manager to execute on weekly ad briefs
  • Repurpose UGC content, testimonials, and influencer clips into winning ad angles
  • Apply performance data to iterate and improve ad creatives week over week
  • Deliver assets fast we move quickly and expect tight turnaround when needed


How to apply?

Apply directly via LinkedIn

Attach your resume and portfolio of previous works

  • We’re looking to hire immediately — so if you’re an editor who gets performance , we’d love to hear from you.

description:
Quem somos?

Com 8 anos de história, a TerraMagna vive a missão de tornar a agricultura tudo aquilo que o mundo precisa que ela seja. Hoje atua como financiadora da cadeia de insumos do agronegócio, visando ser seu sistema operacional e principal parceiro financeiro. title: Cientista de Dados Especialista em IA
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Cientista de Dados Especialista em IA


Descrição da posição


Profissional atuará no desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models), com foco na criação de prompts avançados e agentes de IA, apoiando a evolução de soluções analíticas aplicadas a produtos e plataformas digitais.


A atuação envolve o desenvolvimento de Prompt Engineering, integração com dados estruturados e não estruturados e construção de agentes inteligentes, garantindo qualidade, governança e confiabilidade das respostas geradas pelos modelos.


Responsabilidades


Desenvolver, testar e refinar prompts utilizando técnicas avançadas de Prompt Engineering, como Chain-of-Thought, Few-shot e ReAct

Criar e evoluir agentes de IA baseados em LLMs

Avaliar a performance de diferentes modelos e agentes para casos de uso específicos

Preparar e estruturar dados estruturados e não estruturados para alimentar modelos de linguagem

Garantir que prompts e agentes sigam diretrizes de segurança, governança e ética, evitando alucinações e outputs inconsistentes

Atuar em conjunto com diferentes áreas para integrar soluções de IA generativa em produtos e sistemas

Apoiar na construção de mecanismos de monitoramento e avaliação de outputs gerados por agentes de IA


Requisitos obrigatórios


Formação em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Física ou áreas correlatas

Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de prompts e agentes de IA utilizando sistemas baseados em LLMs

Domínio de Python

Experiência em manipulação e análise de dados utilizando SQL

Experiência com modelagem preditiva e machine learning

Conhecimento do mercado de crédito ou produtos financeiros


  • Idioma: Inglês é considerado um diferencial, mas não obrigatório


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

Profissional atuará no desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models), com foco na criação de prompts avançados e agentes de IA, apoiando a evolução de soluções analíticas aplicadas a produtos e plataformas digitais.


A atuação envolve o desenvolvimento de Prompt Engineering, integração com dados estruturados e não estruturados e construção de agentes inteligentes, garantindo qualidade, governança e confiabilidade das respostas geradas pelos modelos.


Responsabilidades


Desenvolver, testar e refinar prompts utilizando técnicas avançadas de Prompt Engineering, como Chain-of-Thought, Few-shot e ReAct

Criar e evoluir agentes de IA baseados em LLMs

Avaliar a performance de diferentes modelos e agentes para casos de uso específicos

Preparar e estruturar dados estruturados e não estruturados para alimentar modelos de linguagem

Garantir que prompts e agentes sigam diretrizes de segurança, governança e ética, evitando alucinações e outputs inconsistentes

Atuar em conjunto com diferentes áreas para integrar soluções de IA generativa em produtos e sistemas

Apoiar na construção de mecanismos de monitoramento e avaliação de outputs gerados por agentes de IA


Requisitos obrigatórios


Formação em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Física ou áreas correlatas

Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de prompts e agentes de IA utilizando sistemas baseados em LLMs

Domínio de Python

Experiência em manipulação e análise de dados utilizando SQL

Experiência com modelagem preditiva e machine learning

Conhecimento do mercado de crédito ou produtos financeiros


  • Idioma: Inglês é considerado um diferencial, mas não obrigatório


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Senior Credit Risk & Fraud Specialist
description:
Required Skills:


  • Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills;
  • 5+ years of experience in credit risk , fraud analytics , or credit market analysis ;
  • Strong knowledge of the Australian credit ecosystem ;
  • Experience with credit scoring models , risk frameworks , and fraud detection approaches ;
  • Familiarity with credit bureaus and databases used in Australia for credit assessment;
  • Experience working with financial institutions , lenders , or automotive finance ;
  • Ability to provide market insights and benchmarking analysis .


Key Responsibilities:


  • Provide insights into the Australian credit market, particularly related to consumer and commercial vehicle financing;

  • Familiarity with motorcycle financing or dealer financing models;
  • Experience benchmarking banks, lenders, and fintech companies in credit and fraud prevention;
  • Background in risk analytics, financial services consulting, or credit strategy.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
A Immunomatics é uma startup sediada em San Diego, Califórnia, com a missão de melhorar os desfechos dos transplantes de órgãos por meio da seleção otimizada de doadores assistida por inteligência artificial (IA).


A empresa busca contratar profissionais brasileiros com conhecimento avançado em arquiteturas de deep learning.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar, implementar, testar e validar modelos de IA para estratificação de risco.


O que buscamos

  • Pós-graduação em Ciência, Tecnologia, Engenharia ou Matemática.
  • Publicação de artigos científicos envolvendo o uso de redes neurais.
  • Experiência em projetar e implementar novas arquiteturas de redes neurais ou em personalizar arquiteturas existentes (CNN, RNN, Autoencoders, Transformers, etc.) para melhorar o desempenho preditivo do modelo.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de métodos e ferramentas computacionais.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.
  • Fluência em inglês.
  • Bônus: Experiência em Bioinformática.

title: Applications Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) ServiceNow Applications Engineer com forte expertise em AppEngine , desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas e automação de processos, para atuar em um ambiente altamente técnico e colaborativo.

O(a) profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento, governança de plataforma e soluções de automação industrial, combinando visão estratégica, excelência técnica e interação com múltiplas áreas do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e workflows customizados em ServiceNow (AppEngine, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub)
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e aderentes às melhores práticas da plataforma
  • Integrar ServiceNow com sistemas externos via REST/SOAP
  • Criar e manter Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs e UI Policies
  • Orientar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, incluindo code reviews e mentoring
  • Garantir governança da plataforma, reusabilidade e qualidade técnica das entregas
  • Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações de processo e automação industrial, utilizando tecnologias de Controle Avançado e Otimizadores em tempo real
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e colaborando em melhorias cross-funcionais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Experiência sólida com:
  • JavaScript
  • ServiceNow AppEngine
  • Flow Designer
  • Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs, UI Policies
  • Integrações via REST/SOAP
  • Experiência com HRSD, S2P e outros módulos/plugins ServiceNow
  • Vivência com DevOps, ATF e GitHub
  • Experiência em automação industrial / controle de processos
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de refino e processos químicos
  • Experiência com Multivariable Predictive Control (AspenTech DMC, Honeywell RMPCT)
  • Experiência com Real-Time Optimizers (RoMeo ou similares)


Diferenciais

  • Certificações ServiceNow:
  • Flow Designer
  • IntegrationHub
  • Automated Test Framework
  • Service Portal
  • Performance Analytics
  • CSA (Certified System Administrator)
  • CAD (Certified Application Developer)
  • CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist)
  • CTA (Certified Technical Architect)


Onde você vai trabalhar?

100% remoto. No conforto de sua casa.

Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) ServiceNow Applications Engineer com forte expertise em AppEngine , desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas e automação de processos, para atuar em um ambiente altamente técnico e colaborativo.

O(a) profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento, governança de plataforma e soluções de automação industrial, combinando visão estratégica, excelência técnica e interação com múltiplas áreas do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e workflows customizados em ServiceNow (AppEngine, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub)
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e aderentes às melhores práticas da plataforma
  • Integrar ServiceNow com sistemas externos via REST/SOAP
  • Criar e manter Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs e UI Policies
  • Orientar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, incluindo code reviews e mentoring
  • Garantir governança da plataforma, reusabilidade e qualidade técnica das entregas
  • Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações de processo e automação industrial, utilizando tecnologias de Controle Avançado e Otimizadores em tempo real
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e colaborando em melhorias cross-funcionais

  • Experiência sólida com:
  • JavaScript
  • ServiceNow AppEngine
  • Flow Designer
  • Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs, UI Policies
  • Integrações via REST/SOAP
  • Experiência com HRSD, S2P e outros módulos/plugins ServiceNow
  • Vivência com DevOps, ATF e GitHub
  • Experiência em automação industrial / controle de processos
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de refino e processos químicos
  • Experiência com Multivariable Predictive Control (AspenTech DMC, Honeywell RMPCT)

  • CTA (Certified Technical Architect)


Onde você vai trabalhar?

100% remoto. No conforto de sua casa.

title: Technical Project Manager - Cloud
description:
Job Title: Technical Project Manager

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Employment Type: Full Time


Key Responsibilities

• Should have executed large scale Cloud Migrations, SQL, Windows, Apps services, AVS, AVD Migrations or Integrations and Transformations.

• Prepare, track, and manage project schedules, ensuring timely delivery.

• Drive project/program management activities across multiple cloud consulting and migration initiatives.

• Collaborate with stakeholders including clients, offshore teams, and cross-functional groups to deliver transformation goals.

• Oversee governance, project status reporting, and cadence reviews with leadership and internal stakeholders.

• Identify, track, and resolve issues, risks, and escalations across projects.

• Ensure projects are delivered on-time, within budget, and aligned with organizational objectives.


Must Have Skills

✔ 15+ years of experience in cloud transformational consulting and migration projects.

✔ Proven track record of executing large-scale Cloud Migrations, Integrations, and Transformations.

✔ Strong background in Infrastructure (Virtualization, Cloud technologies, compute, storage, networking).

✔ Expertise in planning and managing multiple stakeholders including client, offshore, and cross-functional teams.

✔ Experience with DC migration to Cloud.

✔ Demonstrated ability to drive major IT projects, manage multiple priorities, set timelines, hold teams accountable, and deliver on time and within budget.


Good to Have Skills

• Strong communication skills with effective stakeholder management.

• Excellent time management, prioritization, and organizational skills.

• Experience working with tight deadlines and handling escalations.

• Ability to manage governance, collate project status reports, and present to leadership teams.

• Experience in weekly cadence reviews and reporting to internal stakeholders.

• Ability to track and report schedule and cost variances across projects.

• Skilled in identifying issues, risks, and driving them to closure or mitigation.


Certifications (Preferred)

• Agile Management

• PRINCE2 / PMP (Preferred)

• Other program management certifications


Tools & Technologies (Good to Have)

• ADO or other project management tools

• Azure Cloud

• Databases

• Networking

• Virtualization

• Public Cloud


Educational Qualification

• BCA / MCA / BE / BTech or equivalent


Apply today or share profiles at

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack (Java/Angular) Sr
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Modelo de Trabalho: remoto


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Elaborar e implementar APIs utilizando Java 17+ e Spring Boot 3.3.x.
  • Projetar e desenvolver sistemas com Arquitetura de Eventos utilizando Kafka.
  • Utilizar o ecossistema Spring (Spring Cloud, OpenFeign, JPA/Hibernate, Spring Cloud Stream for Kafka) para desenvolver soluções eficientes.
  • Gerenciar a persistência de dados com PostgreSQL e realizar migrações utilizando Flyway.
  • Implementar interfaces de usuário avançadas utilizando Angular (v14 ou superior).
  • Desenvolver com TypeScript (v5.8) e gerenciar estados/fluxos com RxJS.
  • Realizar estilização com HTML5, SCSS (Sass) e a biblioteca PrimeNG.
  • Garantir a qualidade do código através de testes automatizados com JUnit 5, Mockito, Jasmine/Karma e WireMock.
  • Trabalhar com infraestrutura moderna, incluindo orquestração com Kubernetes (K8s) e conteinerização com Docker.
  • Construir e manter pipelines CI/CD robustos no GitLab CI/CD.
  • Integrar soluções em nuvem utilizando AWS SDK S3.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação completa na área de TI (ou em qualquer área com Pós-Graduação em Engenharia de Software ou Desenvolvimento de Software, reconhecida pelo MEC).
  • Sólida experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento de sistemas, com forte ênfase em backend e frontend.
  • Experiência demonstrada em projetos que envolvam as tecnologias e ferramentas listadas.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe, boa comunicação e habilidades de resolução de problemas.


Informações adicionais:

Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência médica;

title: US Payroll Analyst
description:
The main objective of this role is to review payroll data and documentation for assigned clients, ensuring that all values are accurate based on employees worked hours, guaranteeing traceability and providing consistent, value-added support to clients.


Responsibilities:


  • Review quarterly and annual reports to ensure proper submission of payroll records to the IRS.
  • Input client-reported information for payroll processing.
  • Follow up with clients through meetings and emails to ensure that the information entered into ADP/Accountants World is accurate.
  • Enter information into the Accountants World platform for quarterly clients.
  • Review 1099 forms annually in accordance with information provided by Account Managers.
  • Perform all tasks related to the role based on knowledge and capabilities.


Education:


  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Accounting, or related fields.


Experience:


  • Minimum of 1 year supporting payroll processes.
  • Advanced English level – required.


Skills:


  • Customer Orientation
  • Attention to Detail
  • Learning Agility
  • Communication
  • Teamwork

title: Data Engineer/Back-end engineer
description:
Data Engineer/Back-end engineer - 100% Remote

Location: Remote – Brazil

Mode: 12 Months plus Contract


About the Role


We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Node.js and TypeScript, combined with experience in data engineering, database management, and data modeling. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and optimize scalable data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize backend services using Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Design, implement, and maintain databases and data pipelines.
  • Perform data modeling, data transformation, and integration between systems.
  • Collaborate with data architects, analysts, and software engineers to ensure high-quality data solutions.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize data workflows for performance and scalability.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance and security standards.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience with databases (SQL and NoSQL) and data modeling.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, backend architecture, and data integration patterns.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Excellent communication skills in English or Portuguese.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with ETL pipelines and data warehousing solutions.
  • Familiarity with GraphQL or REST API development.
  • Knowledge of data governance, data security, and compliance.

title: Risk Control Specialist (UTC+8 Night shift)
description:
About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities

  • Conduct user audits on the company's risk control platform
  • Monitor for and promptly respond to any abnormal transaction data, making judgments as necessary
  • Continually learn about the platform's rules and enhance personal and professional skills
  • Keep abreast of external competitors' changes in risk control rules and provide suggestions based on current regulations


Requirements

  • At least 1 year of working experience in risk control/transaction monitoring/customer support
  • Possess business sensitivity and awareness of risk
  • Strong psychological quality with effective communication and judgment skills
  • Strong logical thinking and data collection and analysis abilities
  • Strict adherence to professional ethics and information security and confidentiality in daily work
  • Work Schedule: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM (Brazil Time)


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

  • Strict adherence to professional ethics and information security and confidentiality in daily work

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Business Process Analyst I
description:
Descrição da função:

1. Design e Documentação de Processos GTM

  • Documentar e aprimorar os principais processos de execução de GTM (Go-To-Market), incluindo:
  • Transferência de leads e demanda
  • Fluxo de oportunidades e negociações
  • Adoção, renovações e estratégias de expansão
  • Definir claramente responsabilidades, transições entre equipes e expectativas em cada etapa

  • Criar visualizações simples ou dashboards para identificar problemas e riscos na execução
  • Usar insights para recomendar melhorias específicas nos processos


3. Colaboração Multifuncional

  • Facilitar reuniões de trabalho com times de Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e Operações
  • Registrar decisões e transformá-las em documentação clara
  • Apoiar iniciativas das equipes com análises estruturadas e acompanhamento contínuo

title: Senior Wordpress Developer (Subscription & Circulation Systems)
description:
About Flatiron Software Co.

Flatiron is a fully remote, US-based software company delivering high-impact, modern digital experiences. We work with mission-driven organizations, media groups, and product teams to build scalable, accessible, and performant web platforms. We're currently seeking full-stack developers to join our engineering team, with a strong emphasis on deep WordPress and modern JavaScript experience .


About the Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled Senior WordPress Developer to join our global engineering team. This position focuses on backend development — building and optimizing custom WordPress plugins, APIs, and integrations for large-scale, high-performance websites.

The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of WordPress internals, experience working with enterprise clients, and a strong understanding of scalable, maintainable code.


Responsibilities

  • Integrate WordPress with subscription, paywall, and circulation systems .
  • Build and maintain API integrations between WordPress and external platforms.
  • Ensure reliable synchronization of user data, subscriptions, billing, and content access .
  • Design backend services and middleware to support multi-system communication .
  • Work closely with product and data teams to support subscription and audience workflows.
  • Troubleshoot and optimize data flows across systems for performance and reliability.
  • Develop scalable solutions for high-traffic media platforms .


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of WordPress development experience with backend focus.
  • Strong experience with API integrations and distributed systems .
  • Experience with platforms such as Darwin CX and Naviga NCS Circ .
  • Experience with subscription/paywall systems and audience management platforms.
  • Proficiency in PHP, MySQL, JavaScript, and REST/webhooks.
  • Experience integrating WordPress with external SaaS platforms or enterprise systems .
  • Understanding of authentication, data synchronization, and system reliability.
  • Advanced written and spoken English (international client communication required).


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.



Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.


Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.


Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .


Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.



Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .


Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:
  • FX market microstructure in illiquid markets
  • NDF markets and offshore hedging
  • Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks
  • Hands-on experience building or optimizing:
  • FX trading systems
  • Hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation platforms
  • Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .


Skills

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments .
  • Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks .
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations .
  • Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources .
  • Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies .
  • Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations .
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills
  • Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments



Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Senior Studio Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Senior Studio Specialist at JoVE , you will drive the operational excellence of our in-house creative studio. You will execute and oversee project execution, optimize workflows, and introduce AI-powered solutions to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who understands the full creative production lifecycle and thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment - a love for science is a plus!


Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and coordinate the execution of creative projects from brief to final delivery
  • Maintain the studio production schedule and assign projects to the in-house motion graphics team based on availability, timelines, and project scope.
  • Track the day-to-day progress of projects in the pipeline, follow up on deadlines, flag delays, and ensure workload distribution supports on-time delivery.
  • Define and track KPIs, deadlines, and performance metrics to ensure smooth production cycles
  • Work closely with the Director of Marketing to translate business objectives into actionable creative plans
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to refine briefs and propose effective design solutions
  • Create and edit high-quality video assets to support marketing campaigns, product launches, digital initiatives, and brand awareness efforts.
  • Design, document, and continuously improve studio workflows and cross-functional processes
  • Ensure brand consistency and creative quality standards across all deliverables
  • Identify bottlenecks and implement scalable improvements to increase efficiency
  • Lead the integration of AI technologies into creative workflows, including automation, asset generation, project tracking, and quality optimization


Requirements:

  • 5–7 years of experience in creative production, studio coordination, or motion graphics environments
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent creative projects while ensuring quality and on-time delivery
  • Strong experience supporting and improving production workflows within creative teams
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate designers and balance workloads effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Asana (or similar platforms)
  • Hands-on experience leveraging AI tools to improve production efficiency and creative output
  • Strong attention to detail and quality control across all stages of the creative process
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders
  • Solid understanding of the end-to-end creative production lifecycle (briefing, design, review, revisions, final delivery)


Why Join JoVE?

  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

  • Maintain the studio production schedule and assign projects to the in-house motion graphics team based on availability, timelines, and project scope.

title: Analista de Negócios – Experiência do Cliente & Inteligência de Negócios
description:
O Analista de Negócios é responsável pelo desenvolvimento de dashboards Power BI de nível empresarial e análises Salesforce que impulsionam a excelência operacional, o crescimento da receita, a rentabilidade dos serviços e a tomada de decisões executivas. Essa função atua como o motor de dados e insights para as áreas de Serviço de Campo, Suporte Técnico, Atendimento ao Cliente, Treinamento e Gerenciamento de Projetos.

CONHECIMENTO

  • Administração e Gestão — Conhecimento dos princípios de negócios e gestão envolvidos no planejamento estratégico, alocação de recursos, modelagem de recursos humanos, técnicas de liderança, métodos de produção e coordenação de pessoas e recursos.
  • Economia e Contabilidade — Conhecimento dos princípios e práticas econômicas e contábeis, dos mercados financeiros, do sistema bancário e da análise e divulgação de dados financeiros.
  • Lígua Inglesa - Para está vaga é necessario inglês (avançado), pois haverá interação com todas as empresas do grupo.

title: VMWare VCF Consultant (REMOTE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a VMWare Cloud Engineer expert in Cloud Formation to work remotely for a client in the US.


The VCF expert will design, deploy, and support modern VMware infrastructure. This role focuses on building stable, scalable environments using vSphere, vSAN, NSX, and SRM, while enabling hybrid‑cloud capabilities.


Job location: Remote, work from home, anywhere in Brazil.


MUST BE fluent in English. All interviews will be in English only.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Deploy and manage VCF, including management and workload domains.
  • Implement and optimize vSphere, vSAN, NSX‑T, HCX, and SRM.
  • Troubleshoot issues across compute, storage, and network virtualization.
  • Perform capacity planning, health checks, and risk assessments.
  • Produce documentation and operational handoff materials.
  • Support DR architecture and testing.
  • Provide knowledge transfer to customers and internal teams.



Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT experience
  • MUST BE fluent in English
  • MUST BE an expert in VMWare Cloud Foundation
  • Experience with VCF or large‑scale VMware deployments.
  • Strong understanding of virtualization, networking, and storage.
  • Hands‑on with at least two: vSAN, NSX‑T, HCX, SRM.
  • Familiarity with HCI platforms (e.g. Dell VxRail).
  • Strong troubleshooting and communication skills.

Preferred

  • VMware certifications (VCP/VCAP/VCIX).
  • Experience with automation (PowerCLI, Ansible, Terraform).
  • Exposure to AWS/Azure/GCP and hybrid integrations.
  • Knowledge of backup/storage platforms like PowerStore or Veeam.
  • Previous experience in Consulting and/or client facing roles

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant - Fully Remote


About the job:

We are looking for someone who will help our team with various tasks, has excellent written and spoken English skills, and is attentive to detail and organized.


You will be given various tasks to perform, but your major role is to help us with some marketing activities for our agency and our clients. title: Snowflake Data Engineer
description:
Required Skills & Experience

4+ years of data engineering experience - building data warehouses and ETL pipelines

3+ years of experience with Snowflake Datawarehouse

Strong Python scripting experience

Well versed with data marts

Strong understanding of SQL including: SSIS, SSAS, & SSRS

Ability to work MST hours


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

Experience working within the healthcare industry, provider side highly preferred

Red Shift database experience

Tableau experience

Experience working in an AWS environment

Experience with big data tools: Hadoop, Spark, Kafka


Job Description

A healthcare client of ours is looking for multiple Data Engineers to join their growing team. This team is currently working on a project to modernize on prem SQL warehouses to snowflake. The data warehouse is built, so you will be supporting the build out of data marts on top of their Snowflake enterprise warehouse. This includes lifting and shifting existing data marts, building net new data marts, and further integrations. Additionally, the data engineering team designs, tests, deploys and maintains data pipelines and establishes a strong data reporting environment. This company operates within an AWS environment which is supported by their DevOps team; however, any cloud integration experience could be helpful.


This position is currently slated as a 6-month contract, with high likelihood to extend for an additional 6+ months. Furthermore, this organization has a large pipeline of project work for the next three years, so continuous extensions are likely.

** This role can pay up to $5,000 USD monthly

title: Data Analyst - Senior
description:
Opportunity – Data Analyst (Senior) | Brazil | Remote


Hi everyone,

I’m currently looking for a Data Analyst (Senior level) to join a global project supporting a leading multinational company.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of data, business, and strategy, turning complex datasets into meaningful insights for decision-making.


What we’re looking for:

  • Strong experience in data analysis / business analytics (5+ years)
  • Advanced skills in SQL
  • Experience with Python (or similar)
  • Solid experience with Power BI (or other BI tools)
  • Experience building dashboards, reports, and performance analyses
  • Ability to work with stakeholders and translate data into insights
  • Fluent English (mandatory)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with financial or performance analytics
  • Knowledge of forecasting / statistical modeling
  • Exposure to AWS, Airflow, Spark or similar tools
  • Experience in global / cross-functional environments


Details:

  • Location: Brazil (Remote)
  • Type: Contract
  • Work setup: Home-based
  • Schedule: Full-time

title: Account Manager
description:
THIS ROLE REQUIRES RELOCATING TO TAIWAN FOR 6 MONTHS FOR MANDATORY TRAINING


Main Responsibilities:


  • Develop long-term relationships with key customers, ensuring consistent engagement and satisfaction
  • Oversee and expand revenue streams within an assigned portfolio by identifying growth opportunities
  • Collaborate with clients to improve game visibility and performance through targeted marketing and promotional activities
  • Contribute to securing and maintaining favorable commercial terms in partnerships
  • Coordinate closely with internal marketing teams to deliver high-quality and effective promotional campaigns
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by sharing insights, best practices, and industry knowledge
  • Provide prompt and efficient support to operators, ensuring all requests are handled in a timely manner

  • Previous experience in account management, business development, or similar client-facing roles, ideally within iGaming, gaming, or digital entertainment (preferred but not strictly mandatory)
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build lasting relationships
  • Familiarity with marketing strategies and promotional planning is advantageous
  • Good organizational skills and ability to manage multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Brazilian nationality or eligibility to work in Brazil is required
  • Willingness to undergo an initial training period in Taiwan before transitioning to a role based in Brazil (mandatory)

title: MS D365 CRM Functional Consultant
description:
We never request payment at any stage of our recruitment process, and we only contact candidates through official corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached with any request for payment, it is likely fraudulent. Please verify whether the role you are interested in is posted on our official website.



About TMF Group

TMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing worldwide. We deliver specialized, business‑critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.



Discover the Role

We are seeking a CRM Business Analyst / CRM Functional Consultant who will play a key role in gathering business requirements and supporting implementations of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) . The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail‑oriented, self‑driven and committed to deeply understanding business needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.

Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. If you are driven by challenge, enjoy going the extra mile and want to work with highly talented professionals, this is the opportunity for you.

If you are an experienced Microsoft D365 CRM Functional Consultant seeking dynamic projects and a collaborative team, we encourage you to apply.



Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions tailored to business needs.
  • Configure and customize D365 CRM to meet functional requirements.
  • Work closely with technical teams to integrate CRM with other systems.
  • Participate in project planning, estimating and project management activities.
  • Deliver end‑user training and provide ongoing functional support.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of new D365 CRM features and capabilities.
  • Mentor and guide junior consultants when needed.


Key Requirements

  • Experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM implementation and customization.
  • Experience with version 8.0 or later.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience developing custom workflows, entities and plugins using C# or .NET .
  • Strong understanding of D365 CRM’s data model, security model and configuration options.
  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment.



What’s in It for You?

Career Development

  • Opportunities for internal mobility and career progression.
  • Collaboration with global colleagues and exposure to international clients.
  • Continuous learning supported by the TMF Business Academy .

Making an Impact

  • Direct contribution to simplifying global business operations for our clients.
  • Opportunities to support local communities through our corporate social responsibility initiatives.

A Supportive Environment

  • A strong feedback culture that supports growth and engagement.
  • Flexibility to work from our offices or remotely, promoting work‑life balance.
  • An inclusive environment where people are empowered and encouraged to grow their careers.

At TMF Group, our people define who we are . We thrive on entrepreneurial spirit and value proactive professionals who bring passion, accountability and excellence to everything they do.

We deliver specialized, business‑critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.



Discover the Role

We are seeking a CRM Business Analyst / CRM Functional Consultant who will play a key role in gathering business requirements and supporting implementations of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) . The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail‑oriented, self‑driven and committed to deeply understanding business needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.

Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. If you are driven by challenge, enjoy going the extra mile and want to work with highly talented professionals, this is the opportunity for you.

If you are an experienced Microsoft D365 CRM Functional Consultant seeking dynamic projects and a collaborative team, we encourage you to apply.



Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions tailored to business needs.
  • Configure and customize D365 CRM to meet functional requirements.
  • Work closely with technical teams to integrate CRM with other systems.
  • Participate in project planning, estimating and project management activities.
  • Deliver end‑user training and provide ongoing functional support.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of new D365 CRM features and capabilities.
  • Mentor and guide junior consultants when needed.


Key Requirements

  • Experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM implementation and customization.
  • Experience with version 8.0 or later.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience developing custom workflows, entities and plugins using C# or .NET .
  • Strong understanding of D365 CRM’s data model, security model and configuration options.
  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment.



What’s in It for You?

Career Development

  • Opportunities for internal mobility and career progression.
  • Collaboration with global colleagues and exposure to international clients.
  • Continuous learning supported by the TMF Business Academy .

Making an Impact

  • Direct contribution to simplifying global business operations for our clients.
  • Opportunities to support local communities through our corporate social responsibility initiatives.

A Supportive Environment

  • A strong feedback culture that supports growth and engagement.
  • Flexibility to work from our offices or remotely, promoting work‑life balance.
  • An inclusive environment where people are empowered and encouraged to grow their careers.

At TMF Group, our people define who we are . We thrive on entrepreneurial spirit and value proactive professionals who bring passion, accountability and excellence to everything they do.

Level: Mid-Level

Industry: Software SAAS Company

Shift: US Hours

Start Date: can start in 2 weeks after offer

Equipment: Available upon request

Rate: R$8,000 - R$10,000


About The Methodical Group

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity

Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.

The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
  • Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
  • Configure and customize the SaaS platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
  • Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
  • Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
  • Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
  • Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
  • Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.


Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise SaaS products.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
  • Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Experience using tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Analista de Custos Sr
description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.

Estamos com oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência para todo o grupo.

Descrição Breve do Cargo:

  • Realizar análise de custos, apoiando na elaboração e acompanhamento de orçamentos Agroindustriais,
  • Realizar o rastreio dos lançamentos dos custos,
  • Apoiar a apresentação de custos por atividades, elaborando as apresentações semanais ou mensais através de ferramentas (Dashboard e Power Point),
  • Revisar a estrutura de centros de custos,
  • Calcular e monitorar indicadores de orçamento e produção Agroindustrial,
  • Analisar na busca de soluções para redução de perdas e custos e maior eficiência nos processos Agroindustriais,
  • Realizar o bloqueio de contas, realizar a consolidação das produções e valores (real/ton e vapor/ton)
  • Apuração de custo via app web,
  • Conciliação dos Saldos de Estoques,
  • Atualização e Fechamento do Módulo de Estoques,
  • Avaliação dos lançamentos nas contas de custo
  • Habilidades e vivencias em Inventários,
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas conforme orientação superior.

Instrução:

  • Ensino Completo em Ciências contábeis, engenharias, ou áreas relacionadas a ciências exatas.


Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse: .

title: Consultor Fieldglass
description:
Consultor Sênior SAP Fieldglass

Profissional responsável por liderar integrações entre o SAP Fieldglass (SOW e Timesheet/Rate) e sistemas externos de controle de ponto, garantindo maior precisão, conformidade e automação no processo de faturamento de fornecedores.

Atuará na definição de mapeamento de dados, validação de presença, detecção de anomalias e automação de aprovação/rejeição de faturas, além de otimizar workflows e garantir integrações estáveis.

Principais requisitos:

  • +5 anos com SAP Fieldglass (SOW e folha de ponto/taxas)
  • Forte experiência em integrações e mapeamento de dados
  • Conhecimento em gestão de força de trabalho contingente
  • Experiência com validação de dados e automação de processos

Diferenciais:

  • Integração com sistemas de ponto/acesso (ex: Alert Enterprise)
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA
  • Vivência em ambientes globais e de alto volume

Perfil esperado: visão de processos, capacidade analítica, autonomia e forte atuação com stakeholders.

Atuará na definição de mapeamento de dados, validação de presença, detecção de anomalias e automação de aprovação/rejeição de faturas, além de otimizar workflows e garantir integrações estáveis.

Principais requisitos:

  • +5 anos com SAP Fieldglass (SOW e folha de ponto/taxas)
  • Forte experiência em integrações e mapeamento de dados
  • Conhecimento em gestão de força de trabalho contingente
  • Experiência com validação de dados e automação de processos

Diferenciais:

  • Integração com sistemas de ponto/acesso (ex: Alert Enterprise)
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA
  • Vivência em ambientes globais e de alto volume

Perfil esperado: visão de processos, capacidade analítica, autonomia e forte atuação com stakeholders.

title: Supervisor(a) de vendas - Cachoeirinha (RS)
description:
Descrição da vaga

NOSSO MAIOR CRÉDITO É A CONFIANÇA DAS PESSOAS.

Somos um grande time conectado pelos mesmos valores, e para cumprirmos essa missão, acreditamos que a confiança é fundamental nessa jornada.

Queremos sempre estar junto, somando forças e experiências para oferecer o melhor atendimento aos clientes.

Aqui na help incentivamos a participação de variados públicos em nossos processos seletivos, promovendo a candidatura de pessoas negras, mulheres, LGBTQIAP+, acima dos 50 anos e PCDs. Desse modo, não enviesamos perguntas de cunho pessoal, favorecendo e tornando nosso ambiente mais inclusivo, diverso e respeitoso, buscando aumentar a pluralidade dos times.

E nossas vagas são para todos que sintam essa vontade inquietante de pertencer e compor um time único, confiante e forte que tem orgulho de dizer: #somoshelpers!

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • O Supervisor de Vendas realizará a gestão dos consultores da loja: acompanhar as vendas, dar suporte, contribuir com o desenvolvimento da equipe e garantir a entrega dos resultados;
  • Responsável por todos os processos administrativos da equipe;
  • Desenvolvimento e acompanhamento das estratégias comerciais;
  • Vendas de produtos financeiros e acionamentos junto à equipe;
  • Divulgação dos produtos;
  • Responsável pela abertura e fechamento da loja.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Necessário que o Supervisor de Vendas possua experiência com gestão de equipe de vendas de qualquer produto;
  • Necessário ter experiência com vendas e trabalhado com metas;
  • Desejável atuação com vendas de multiprodutos e experiências com vendas ativas por telefone e presenciais;
  • Perfil do Supervisor de Vendas: Proativo, resiliente, dinâmico, comunicativo, habilidade em negociação, organizado, senso de urgência, foco no cliente e nos resultados de vendas.
  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Conhecimento no Pacote Office.


Informações adicionais

Remuneração


Salário Fixo + Remuneração Variável + Bônus


Benefícios, saúde e bem-estar:


  • Plano de saúde após 90 dias com coparticipação de 30% em consultas e exames simples Telemedicina;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • help investe em você - plataforma educacional com + de 60 instituições de ensino;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Salário fixo + Comissão;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Parceria Gympass;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Psicologia Viva - Sessões de terapia online gratuita;
  • PAP - Programa de assessoria financeira, jurídica e psicológica.


Horário de trabalho do Supervisor de Vendas (vaga presencial):

  • Segunda a quinta das 08h às 18h
  • Sexta feira das 08h às 17h


E por fim, e mais importante, acreditamos no protagonismo dos nossos colaboradores, afinal, não é apenas sobre métodos, agilidade e digitalização. É sobre pessoas e o potencial que elas têm!

title: Líder Técnico III (React Native/NodeJS)
description:
Descrição da vaga

O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar com liderança técnica de projetos de software, no Inatel Competence Center - ICC.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Liderar tecnicamente times e projetos de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Atuar na definição de soluções técnicas alinhadas às necessidades do negócio, considerando requisitos de escalabilidade, confiabilidade, segurança, disponibilidade e desempenho;
  • Definir, documentar e validar arquiteturas lógicas e executáveis de sistemas;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica, arquitetural, operacional e de apoio à gestão dos projetos;
  • Realizar especificação funcional e técnica de sistemas e aplicações;
  • Prover soluções e suporte ao desenvolvimento de funcionalidades de aplicativos móveis e web;
  • Desenvolver aplicações de alto nível de complexidade técnica;
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de QA, apoiando estratégias de testes e qualidade;
  • Revisar códigos-fonte, garantindo aderência a boas práticas, padrões de projeto e qualidade de software;
  • Projetar soluções com foco em integração e entrega contínua (CI/CD);
  • Atuar como referência técnica, promovendo capacitação, mentoria e suporte aos desenvolvedores;
  • Planejar, acompanhar e monitorar as atividades técnicas dos projetos sob sua responsabilidade;
  • Apoiar decisões técnicas relacionadas à evolução do projeto, arquitetura e infraestrutura.


Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino superior completo em cursos da área de tecnologia, tais como Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Experiência sólida em liderança técnica de projetos de software ;


Desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando React Native , Expo e Node.js ;


Vivência com:

  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou similares);
  • Atuação em ambientes com cultura DevOps .
  • Desenvolvimento de aplicativos móveis e aplicações web;
  • Design e definição de arquitetura de aplicações móveis e backend ;
  • Bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais ;
  • Desenvolvimento e consumo de Web Services e APIs REST ;
  • Aplicação de Design Patterns e boas práticas de engenharia de software;
  • Modelagem e documentação de projetos;
  • Ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex.: Git) e análise de qualidade de código;


Atuação prévia com AWS (Amazon Web Services) , incluindo:

  • Conceitos de arquitetura em nuvem;
  • Uso de serviços como EC2, S3, RDS/DynamoDB, Lambda, API Gateway e CloudWatch;
  • Boas práticas de segurança, escalabilidade e alta disponibilidade;
  • Apoio à definição de pipelines e ambientes em nuvem.


Forte atuação com:

  • Comunicação Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) ;
  • Comunicação em rede CAN ;
  • Publicação e distribuição de aplicativos nas lojas Apple App Store e Google Play ;
  • Criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD para build, testes e deploy;
  • Testes automatizados;
  • Ferramentas e conceitos de UX/UI Design .


Informações adicionais

Horário de Trabalho: de segunda à sexta-feira das 08h00 às 12h00 e das 13h30 às 17h30.


Local de Trabalho: as atividades serão realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho \"Home Office\".
